title: Tight universality of $m$-gonal forms with minimal criterion sets
summary: For integers $m\geq3$ and $n\geq1$, an $m$-gonal form is called tight $\mathcal{T}(n)$-universal if it represents exactly the positive integers $\mathcal{T}(n)=\{ n, n+1, n+2, \ldots \}$. In this paper, we study the minimal criterion set $\mathrm{CS}(m,n)$ for tight $\mathcal{T}(n)$-universality. Our main result determines $\mathrm{CS}(m,n)$ for all $n \geq8$, $3 \leq m \leq \left\lfloor \frac{3n+1}{2} \right\rfloor$. More precisely, \[ \mathrm{CS}(m,n)= \begin{cases} \{ n, n+1, \ldots, 2n-1 \}, & m=5,\newline \{ n, n+1, \ldots, 2n \}, & m\neq5. \end{cases} \] We also establish the…
